name: record-list
title: Record List
description: A numbered list of the records a change affects — a muted record-type icon, the name with a new-tab link after it, a badge and a description line — plus a Show more footer whose next rows keep the numbering. For confirmation dialogs.

meta.whenToUse: The records a change will touch, listed in a confirmation dialog (the products a save affects, the products a delete leaves), each with a link to open it in a new tab.
meta.whenNotToUse: Navigable or selectable lists (Item, DataList), pickers (Combobox), or a single linked record (RecordChip).
